title: Nightly cosmetics: banner, popup, production rows
description: The cosmetic findings of the 2026-10-08 nightly, reproduced on the base commit and fixed. Before shots are taken on the base commit and committed under before/; after shots and the Playwright measurements (no overlap, controls on top at their centre, every production row reachable) are regenerated with npm run screenshots -- BH. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server.

shots.heading: Before: prepare banner over the question, short desktop window
shots.caption: The Preparing banner floats over the top of the stand-in question and covers its title (nightly runs 44 and 60). The dialog was centred in the whole screen, so a window that is not tall enough puts them on top of each other.

shots.heading: After: question starts below the banner, short desktop window
shots.caption: The dialog starts under the banner (padding measured from it) and scrolls inside the rest.

shots.heading: After: banner folded, short desktop window
shots.caption: The fold control now exists on windows up to 640 px high too; folded, the whole question fits.

shots.heading: Before: phone 390x844
shots.caption: The banner docks at the bottom; a tall question had its lower part (and buttons) under it.

shots.heading: After: phone 390x844, banner open
shots.caption: The dialog ends above the docked banner; title, Spend and Skip clear of it.

shots.heading: After: phone 390x844, banner folded
shots.caption: Folded banner, 58 px; the question gets the room back.

shots.heading: After: phone 360x740
shots.caption: Same at 360 px.

shots.heading: Before: landscape 844x390
shots.caption: The docked banner at the right edge lies over the right of the question (Spend and the minimize control).

shots.heading: After: landscape 844x390
shots.caption: The question is padded away from the banner on the left side.

shots.heading: After: landscape, folded
shots.caption: Folded banner, the question keeps most of the width.

shots.heading: Before: system popup over the activation bar, 390x844
shots.caption: The popup reaches y=759, the Confirm Activation bar starts at y=688: Confirm and Cancel are partly under the popup (nightly runs 21 and 25).

shots.heading: After: popup ends above the bar, 390x844
shots.caption: The popup's bottom edge follows the measured top of the bar. Confirm Activation and Cancel are the topmost elements at their centres.

shots.heading: Before: 360x740
shots.caption: Same overlap.

shots.heading: After: 360x740
shots.caption: Clear.

shots.heading: Desktop 1280x720
shots.caption: The popup already ended at y=470 above the bar at y=632 here; the guarantee is now measured instead of a fixed 250 px inset, so a taller bar (error line, wrapped label) moves the popup up on desktop as well.

shots.heading: Desktop with the event log open
shots.caption: No overlap with the activation bar. The bar itself lies over the event-log rows, which is the existing floating-bar design.

shots.heading: Landscape 844x390
shots.caption: Popup and bar do not overlap (the popup has its 160 px minimum).

shots.heading: Before: production builder, desktop 1280x720
shots.caption: The Dreadnought row is cut by the sticky Reset / Confirm / Done bar (nightly run 30). The dialog scrolls and every row is reachable at the end of the scroll; what was wrong is the hard cut, and that a focused row could land under the bar.

shots.heading: After: desktop
shots.caption: Tighter spacing on short screens shows more rows, the bar fades the rows behind it, and scroll-padding keeps a focused or scrolled-to row above the bar.

shots.heading: After: end of the scroll, desktop
shots.caption: The last row clears the bar.

shots.heading: Before: phone 390x844
shots.caption: Top of the dialog on a phone.

shots.heading: After: phone 390x844
shots.caption: Top of the dialog.

shots.heading: After: end of the scroll, 390x844
shots.caption: Last rows fully visible above the bar (64 px bottom padding keeps clear of Players / Events).

shots.heading: After: 360x740
shots.caption: Top of the dialog.

shots.heading: After: landscape 844x390
shots.caption: Top of the dialog on a landscape phone.

shots.heading: After: landscape, end of the scroll
shots.caption: Every row's - and + reachable (measured with elementFromPoint after scrolling each row to the centre and the last to the end).

notesHeading: Checked and left as it is

notes.title: Support for the Throne in both trade columns
notes.text: Correct. The staging desk offers each side its own copy of the note (a toggle per side; the swap hands over both copies), and the answer view names them by owner: 'Support (hacan)' in You give, 'Support (sol)' in You receive. No change.

notes.title: Activation bar over the event log
notes.text: With the docked event log open the floating activation bar lies over its rows. That is the floating-bar design (it must stay reachable); not changed.
